item.text:
Fixed rollout parsing so `0.10` means 10% and `0.25` means 25%. Removed the `new_checkout` special case, which had incorrectly expanded its rollout and bypassed deny rules. Added a regression test confirming `u0200` is included for `warehouse_pick` at 25%.

`python -m pytest -q` passes: **8 passed**.
